# only-one-when

Allow at most one When step per Scenario.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| structure | no | no | none |

Allows at most one explicit `When` step per Scenario. `And` after `When` does not count.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "only-one-when": "error" } }
```

## Triggered by

```text
When I pay
When I cancel
```
